agent_explanation: Controller demand kp*velocity-error exceeds fmax for many steps and is correctly clamped at exactly fmax (steps 332-333). At step 334 with very similar state (speed slightly lower, 2 substeps, no contacts) the reported force 214.479 exceeds fmax 156.009, so the fmax clamp was bypassed/mis-scaled on that step (likely substep force accumulation or clamp applied per-substep but summed). Lowering kp removes saturation and removes failure.
